artworks.title: Passez au large!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large urn labeled "Suffrage Universel" being guarded by a rotund figure holding a staff, with a crowd looking on from the background.

artworks.title: Aux Champs-Elysées, Ratapoil. Par suite d'une délibération philantropique [sic] du Comité du dix Décembre...à deux sous à club...deux sous...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The drawing features a man with exaggerated facial features wearing a top hat, holding sticks under one arm while another stick points upwards. He is surrounded by indistinct figures in suits and top hats. The background is sketched lightly, indicating a street setting.

artworks.title: Le sire de Berryer ...Chevalier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals in a caricatured style. One person is kneeling, while the other is standing holding a large stick above the kneeling figure's head. The style features exaggerated features characteristic of caricatures and suggests a contrast between the characters. The scene appears to depict a satirical or ceremonial moment. The linework is bold and distinctive, emphasizing the comical nature of the illustration.

artworks.title: Casmajou -- Ratapoil (tous deux en choeur)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two skeletal figures dressed in tattered clothing, standing facing each other. Each figure holds a walking stick and wears hats and coats that accentuate their skeletal features. Their expressions suggest conversation. The illustration uses strong lines and shadowing to create a dramatic effect. It includes a dialogue below, adding a narrative layer to the image.

artworks.title: Ma femme, t'as tort de me blamer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people. The man is sitting with his eyes closed, reclined back, and his head tilted to the side. He has dark, curly hair, a notable nose and appears to be resting. He is wearing a striped suit, and there is a bottle on the nearby table. The woman stands beside him, facing him. She is wearing a head covering and high-collared attire. Her facial expression is serious as she looks at the man. The background is depicted with lines and shading, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Vous m'excuserez: je vais me mettre a table ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals engaged in conversation. One man is leaning over a railing, while the other man is below him, looking up. The man leaning over the railing has a thoughtful expression and short hair under a hat, wearing a dark coat over a lighter shirt. He has one hand on the railing and is gesturing downward. The man below him is slightly hunched, wearing a formal suit with a vest, shirt, necktie, and a top hat. Both men have aged facial features with distinct lines and expressions. There are no visible accessories, and the background shows a shaded, textured interior setting with a staircase and a wall. The scene is rendered in grayscale with illustrative sketching.

artworks.title: L'empereur soulouque ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing features animated caricature figures in a comical scene. Three figures on the left confront a fourth figure on the right. The figure on the right wears a pointed hat and is holding quill feathers. The left figures have exaggerated facial features and expressions. The setting includes draped curtains in the background. One figure holds a pitchfork and a publication labeled 'Univers.' The drawing is reminiscent of a political cartoon.

artworks.title: Ce bon M. Ratapoil leur a promis ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures with exaggerated features gazing at birds in the sky, accompanied by another figure in the distance. The scene captures a satirical or humorous portrayal, typical of the caricature style, with two central figures standing side by side, looking upwards eagerly at a distant flock of birds. The linework is deliberate and offers a sense of whimsy.

artworks.title: Un jour de revue
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person's bust and an outstretched arm holding a stick with a piece of clothing tied to it. The person has exaggerated facial features, an elongated face, disheveled dark hair, and is dressed in an indistinct shirt or coat. There are other figures around, some holding similar sticks with hats. In the background, there is a field with a group of people, possibly riding horses, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Ils voudraient éteindre jusqu'au soleil
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image features two caricatured figures attempting to extinguish the sun. One person stands on top of the other, both holding a large bell-shaped object. The sun has a human face and shines bright rays of light. The lower figure seems to be struggling. Various elements like lamp posts and inscriptions like "LIBERTÉ DE LA PRESSE" and "ENSEIGNEMENT" are present, suggesting themes of freedom of the press and education. The artwork likely serves as a satirical commentary on censorship or control, with humor and exaggeration.

artworks.title: Un Bonapartiste nouvellement converti
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one arm extended, pointing, and looking towards the viewer. He wears a hat, a dark garment, and holds a stick labelled "RUMESSON D'HONNEUR, BONNE ETAT MA." In the background, there is a sketched portrait marked "HENRI" on the wall with another smaller picture below it. The setting has a sketchy and illustrative style.

artworks.title: Une séance de l'union électorale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring animated figures in a disorganized and frenzied meeting. The figures appear to be engaged in a disagreement or scuffle, with some gesturing dramatically and others physically tussling. Various objects are scattered around the scene, including an umbrella and a chair. The exaggerated features and caricatured expressions suggest a satirical depiction, emphasizing the absurdity and disorder of the situation. The dynamic composition and exaggerated characters imply a sense of tumult and humor in the scene.

artworks.title: Moi,  j'ai habitude de ne ... rien donner
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of four men in a café setting. Two men in the foreground have visible upper bodies. One man is seated at a small round table holding a cup, and the other man is standing beside him leaning in for a conversation. Both men have distinct facial features. The seated man has a wrinkled forehead and receding hairline, while the standing man has a pronounced nose and untamed hair. The seated man wears a dark jacket, and the standing man dresses formally. A newspaper is on the table in front of them. In the background, there are two other seated men, their profiles visible but not detailed. The background includes textured shading reminiscent of a wall or curtain commonly found in cafes.

artworks.title: Amateurs parisiens profitant du séjour de Rossini
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features three individuals engaged in musical activity. In the center, a woman sits at a piano with her hands on the keys. To her left is a man looking towards her, and to her right is another man. The individuals are dressed in formal attire and appear to be singing. The background is nondescript, with a music score on the piano.

artworks.title: Examinant le nouveau plafond ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of five men from the waist up looking upwards. They are dressed in formal 19th-century attire, with some wearing top hats. The men have a mix of older and middle-aged appearances, with various facial features. The background is lightly sketched, hinting at an indoor setting with faint structural elements in the background.

artworks.title: Une famille mélomane ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals from the waist up, positioned close together. The central figure is an older man with elongated facial features, sharp nose, and thin lips, wearing a tall, floppy hat. To his left, a younger woman with dark, curly hair, partially visible, seems to lean towards him. To the right, another youthful character with short hair styled with curls or tufts participates with an animated expression. The man holds a piece of sheet music in front of them. The background consists of shaded, textured lines resembling curtains or drapes.

artworks.title: Le docteur Véron refusant ... consolation
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures entwined in a dynamic interaction. The central figure holds two smaller figures, one in each arm. The smaller figures have wings. The central figure has a strong and muscular build, with drapery flowing around them. The background is a dark, stormy sky with swirling clouds. The line work and shading create depth and texture, enhancing the dramatic effect of the image.

artworks.title: Enlèvement d'une fille de l'air
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a floating figure and two observers on a balcony. The scene shows exaggerated caricatures, with a figure floating in the air reaching out towards two men on a balcony. The men have exaggerated features and expressions, with one wearing a bowler hat and the other wearing a top hat. Below is a sketch of a town or city landscape, possibly Paris, as seen from a great height. Dialogue is included underneath to add context to the encounter.

artworks.title: Conducteur ... j'avais pris vos messageries ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a train scene. The drawing features a caricatured train carriage marked "MESSAGERIES GENERALES" with exaggerated and distorted figures reaching out in distress or complaint toward a figure in a top hat standing on the platform. The characters within the train seem dramatically expressive. The illustration contains text elements at the top ("PHYSIONOMIES DES CHEMINS DE FER") and a dialogue at the bottom.

artworks.title: A qui penses-tu donc, coquenard? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures walking together. The image shows two individuals strolling side by side. One person gestures emphatically while the other appears downcast. The figures are depicted in a sketch-like style with loose, flowing lines and shading. The background features a sparse landscape suggested with light pencil strokes. Text above the image reads "TOUT CE QU'ON VOUDRA." Below the figures, there is French dialogue presented as a conversation between the characters. This drawing captures a moment of interaction and emotional expression through posture and facial details, typical of illustration work with a hint of social commentary.

artworks.title: Toutes le Parisiennes qui possèdent des chiens ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of women with dogs in front of a building. The image shows women holding small dogs or leading them on leashes, as they gather around the entrance with the word "CONSTITUTION" above. The women are dressed in long gowns and shawls. There is a line of text in French at the bottom. The shading and style suggest a satirical tone common in newspapers or periodicals of that era.

artworks.title: Oh! Monsieur, quel talent possède ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men from the waist up talking. The man on the left has a rounded face, a receding hairline, and a double chin, wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and bow tie. The man in the middle has a prominent nose and a wide smile, with slicked-back hair, wearing a similar dark suit and bow tie. The man on the right is looking earnestly at the man in the middle, with a semi-open mouth and expressive eyes, slightly messy hair, and formal attire. In the background, there are several other people, with some interacting with what appears to be a piano or desk. The background suggests an interior setting through broader strokes and shading.

artworks.title: Un train de plaisir aérien
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of a hot air balloon with four passengers. The passengers have exaggerated facial expressions and are depicted in caricature style. The drawing shows the passengers in a cramped basket, wearing oversized top hats and unique clothing. French text near the bottom adds to the scene.

artworks.title: Le danger de faire voir a des enfants ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a vintage illustration of a crowded scene with several people visible from the waist up. In the center, an adult male in a top hat and holding glasses is interacting with a baby dressed in a checkered outfit and a large bonnet, who appears to be crying. A woman in a bonnet is leaning towards them with a smile. Other adults are also visible, with one wearing a cap and another with glasses. The background shows an art gallery with multiple frames on the walls, indoor architectural elements like pillars, and framed artworks, suggesting a public exhibition or similar venue.
